name: Niagara Fluids Volume Rendering
definition: Repurposes a grid-based physics simulation system for volume rendering by ignoring the simulation step ('do nothing' simulation) and using only the rendering pipeline.
summary: Niagara Fluids Volume Rendering is a UE5 method that repurposes the fluid simulation pipeline for volumetric display, distinguished by its severe VRAM constraints due to underlying grid memory allocation.
